messages:
Maya: Morning — quick async for the sprint-lite slice. Drop 1–2 line updates (yesterday / blockers / today). If you have a spec ask or prioritization concern, flag it here. Linking the spec: https://redwood.internal/specs/sprint-lite-v2

Ben: Yesterday: landed the batching change in runtime (PR #412). Perf looks good for short seqs but I saw a p99 regression on 512-token paths. Blocker: need to reproduce reliably. Today: triaging perf + adding perf test harness. Asking @Leah to eyeball canary config before I flip traffic. PR: https://github.com/redwood/pr/412

Leah: Can you paste the exact repro command/log? If it's the KV cache cold miss we saw last week we can try the fallback patch. Also what's the canary qps target you want?

Ben: Repro command below — run locally against staging model:v2-canary with seq=512:
```
python benchmark.py --model staging:v2-canary --seq 512 --qps 5 --iters 200
# p99 spikes to ~420ms intermittently, typical ~220ms
```
I set canary qps target to 30% of baseline throughput (so ~1.2k r/s). If we need lower to keep latency SLOs, we can adjust.

Rory: QA: found flaky in embed-cache integration test. Fails ~2/10 runs. Snippet: 
```
AssertionError: expected 64 dims got 0 dims
  at test/embed_cache_test.py:47
```
Happens after a few warmup requests, looks related to eviction timing. Running longer loop now to gather more traces.

Tom: UX: small tweak on rollout modal — label for "fallback model" needs to be clearer (product confused it with fallback region). Proposed label: "Fallback model (compat variant)". If we can update the spec text we can ship as part of this sprint. @Maya can you confirm priority?

Maya: Priority: make the rollout modal text clearer — low-risk but high ROI for clarity, please include in the spec doc. Ben/Tom pair on UX+backend change. Leah — can you ping infra for canary capacity limit increase (temp) so Ben can run the performance test without hitting throttles? If infra says no, we'll lower canary qps to 15%.

Leah: Will ping infra now. Also flagged a quick canary guard in the config — adding `max_inflight_requests: 300` to avoid overload. Ben, can you test with that?

Ben: Yes will test with `max_inflight_requests: 300`. Leaving detailed notes in PR for visibility. Thanks for the quick guard. :thumbsup:

Rory: Once canary is up I'll run the flaky-test loop against it and attach traces. If failures persist I'll file a separate bug with trace + repro.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging at 2025-03-10T14:02:12Z — job #789 (canary:v2-canary -> staging-pool-3). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/789

Ben: Noted deployment. Starting perf harness against staging now, will report numbers in thread.

Maya: Thanks all — if anything blocks please call out in-thread. If we need a 10m sync we can do one after Rory confirms test loop.

Rory: Will update in ~30m after the run.

Ben: quick note: added a small benchmark output to PR description so reviewers can see baseline vs canary numbers.

Leah: infra replied: temp capacity approved for staging-pool-3 until EOD. Approved by infra-team.

Maya: Perfect. Closing the async loop unless new blockers show up. :white_check_mark:
